Dear ggtree community,

I would like to plott its phylogenetic tree including the amino acid changes in the branches (as in the figure 1.4 in the book of Prof.Yu).  I am using a nwk tree first generated in CLC software and them the fasta alignment of those proteins as the following:
 
library(phangorn)
library(treeio)
library(ggtree)
#parsing the data
treefile <- system.file("work", "NA.nwk", package="treeio")
tre <- read.tree(treefile)
tipseqfile <- system.file("work", "NA.fa", package="treeio")
tipseq <- read.phyDat(tipseqfile,format="fasta")
fit <- pml(tre, tipseq, k=4)
fit <- optim.pml(fit, optNni=FALSE, optBf=T, optQ=T,
                 optInv=T, optGamma=T, optEdge=TRUE,
                 optRooted=FALSE, model = "GTR",
                 control = pml.control(trace =0))
pmltree <- as.treedata(fit)
ggtree(pmltree) + geom_text(aes(x=branch, label=AA_subs, vjust=-.5))

I got no tree and the following error:

Error in read.phyDat(tipseqfile, format = "fasta") :
  sequences have different length
> fit <- pml(tre, tipseq, k=4)
Error in pml(tre, tipseq, k = 4) : object 'tipseq' not found
> fit <- optim.pml(fit, optNni=FALSE, optBf=T, optQ=T,
+                  optInv=T, optGamma=T, optEdge=TRUE,
+                  optRooted=FALSE, model = "GTR",
+                  control = pml.control(trace =0))
Error in optim.pml(fit, optNni = FALSE, optBf = T, optQ = T, optInv = T,  :
  object 'fit' not found
> pmltree <- as.treedata(fit)
Error in as.treedata(fit) : object 'fit' not found
> ggtree(pmltree) + geom_text(aes(x=branch, label=AA_subs, vjust=-.5))
Error in ggplot(tr, mapping = mapping, layout = layout, mrsd = mrsd, as.Date = as.Date,  :
  object 'pmltree' not found

Could someone help me to add those AA substitutions to that tree? I will be happy to send you a chocolate from Belgium as a well deserved prize. Thank you.

Kind regards

JP
